description.describe_ch: 本課程為終端課程並延續上學期研究主題與實驗規劃，進行實驗、數據分析與探討，最後進行實驗報告的撰寫與海報發表，期望學生可獲得全方面之學習，以培養獨立思考及解決問題之能力。
description.describe_eh: This course is a terminal course and continues the research theme and experiment planning of the previous semester, conducts experiments, data analysis, and discussion, and finally writes experimental reports and publishes posters. It is expected that students can learn in all aspects to cultivate independent thinking and problem-solving ability.

targets.describe_ch: 培養團隊合作進行材料工程相關實驗設計之能力。
targets.describe_en: Be able to organize a team for performing materials experiments and designs.

targets.describe_ch: 培養團隊合作進行設計材料製程或元件，並分析其操作數據之能力。
targets.describe_en: Be able to organize a team for designing materials processes or devices, and analyzing the performance data.

targets.describe_ch: 培養材料工程實驗技術、技巧及使用工具之能力。
targets.describe_en: Be able to executing materials experimental skills/techniques and utilizing experimental tools.

targets.describe_ch: 能清楚規劃研究之主題及各項參數之設定，並能以口頭方式將所獲結果清楚表達與研究團隊及指導教師溝通。
targets.describe_en: Be able to understand clearly how to plan projects and the meanings of each parameter in experiment. Be able to express experiment results clearly and well communicate with research team members and supervisors.

targets.describe_ch: 透過實驗之規畫進行，能使用相關設備，管理實驗經費，並由實驗中歸納出適當結論。
targets.describe_en: Through experiment organizing and executing, students will be able to operate relative experimental instruments, manage budget and conclude proper results from experiments.

targets.describe_ch: 於規劃及執行研究之過程，培養發掘並解決問題之能力。
targets.describe_en: Be able to identify and address problems during planning and executing research projects.

targets.describe_ch: 培養工程專業道德與團隊責任感責任感
targets.describe_en: Be able to maintain engineering ethic and responsibility as a research team member.

targets.describe_ch: 從課程訓練中，培養學生解決複雜整合性問題，主動、終身學習之能力。
targets.describe_en: From these training courses, students ought to resolve complicated and integrated problems, and will be able to

targets.describe_ch: 理解三大材料專業學程含高性能合金與積層製造、奈米電子元件與智慧感測、再生能源材料與永續發展領域技術原理及應用
targets.describe_en: Understanding the technical principles and applications of the three major materials professional programs, including high-performance alloys and additive manufacturing, nanoelectronic devices and smart sensing, renewable energy materials and sustainable development.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: 計畫書50％ 期末發表50％ 依「逢甲大學材料科學與工程學系專題實作修課須知」辦理。此外，也會針對於出缺席狀況進行調整分數。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 尊重和考慮其他學生之感受，意外的噪音和動作會自動轉移和吸引人們的注意力，如服裝禮儀、課堂食物/飲料、聲音(音樂、講話、敲打等)、誇大動作等。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 希望各位同學能按授課進度完成各項學習任務，有規矩地、主動積極地參與各項學習活動、準時繳交作業，完成各項學習任務，並符合本課程的學 習目標者，以獲得應得的成績。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 針對期末繳交書面報告要遵守學術誠信，避免抄襲其他著作。此外，針對使用的文獻都要適時進行引用以避免著作權問題。

courseBankC.describe_ch: 培養工程專業道德與團隊責任感責任感

courseBankC.core_eng: Understand and apply professional and information ethics, recognize social responsibility and respect diverse perspectives.

courseBankC.describe_en: Understanding the technical principles and applications of the three major materials professional programs, including high-performance alloys and additive manufacturing, nanoelectronic devices and smart sensing, renewable energy materials and sustainable development.
courseBankC.core_item: 運用數學、材料科學及工程知識的能力。
courseBankC.core_eng: Possess fundamental mathematical and materials science and engineering skills.
